'''Arpat Avanesyan''' is a Physicist and legislator from [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]].<ref>
{{cite news
 |url=http://www.yerevanreport.com/5397/ghulyan-reelected-speaker-nagorno-karabakh-parliament/ 
 |title=Ghulyan Re-elected as Speaker of Nagorno-Karabakh Parliament 
 |publisher=[[Yerevan Report]] 
 |author=Victoria Vardanyan 
 |date=2010-06-11 
 |accessdate=2013-10-21 
 |archivedate=2013-10-22 
 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20131022202751/http://www.yerevanreport.com/5397/ghulyan-reelected-speaker-nagorno-karabakh-parliament/ 
 |url-status=dead 
 |quote=The first session, in accordance with the Constitution of the Republic of Nagorno-Karabakh, was held by the most senior deputy in age, Arpat Avanesyan. 
}}
</ref><ref>
{{cite news 
| url         = http://oxbridgepartners.com/hratch/index.php/publications/articles/63-on-campus-in-karabakh
| title       = On Campus in Karabakh
| publisher   = [[Armenian International Magazine]]
| author      = Hratch Tchilingirian
| date        = March 1996
| page        = 
| location    = 
| isbn        = 
| accessdate  = 2013-10-21
| quote       = Currently rector Levon Yepiskoposian, 44, a biologist from Armenia, and former rector Arpat Avanesian, together instigated the establishment of departments of civil engineering, airport construction, telecommunication, electropower and technology, military studies, milk production, wine production, natural resource utilization, food preservation and economics, among others.
}}
</ref>
Avanesyan is a past Rector of the [[State University of Mountainous Karabakh]].
He chairs the legislature's Finance Committee.<ref>

<!--
=Biography and Activities=
A. Avanesyan was born on January 2, 1944, in Chartar village in Martuni region.

*1960- finished Chartar Secondary School.
*1966- graduated from Yerevan State University, the Faculty of Physics, Department- Radiophysics and Electronics, with the speciality of radiophysicist.
*1965-1968- senior engineer at the Institute of Mechanics in the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Armenia.
*1968- assistant at the chair of Atomic Physics of Yerevan Polytechnic Institute.
*1981- graduated from post-graduate course and became a candidate of Technical Sciences, 1983- Associate  Professor.
*1990- director of the Technical Department of Stepanakert branch of Yerevan Polytechnic Institute.
*1991- rector of Yerevan Polytechnic Institute of Stepanakert branch.
*1992- first rector of Nagorno Karabakh State University (later on: Artsakh State University).
*1994, July- Associate Professor at Artsakh State University, October, 2004- Head of the Chair.
*June 19, 2005- elected deputy of the National Assembly of NKR of the fourth convocation by proportional electoral system from “Free Motherland” Party, was the chairman of the Standing Committee of the National Assembly on Social Affairs.
*December 13, 2007- being suggested the adviser of the Prime Minister, he interrupted his deputy powers.
*May 23, 2010- elected deputy of the National Assembly of NKR of the fifth convocation, elected directly, electoral district N13.
*June 10, 2010- elected chairman of the Standing Committee on Finacial-budgetary and Economic  Affairs in the first plenary session of the National Assembly.

Is a member of “Free Motherland” Party, the faction “Hayrenik”.

Awarded NKR “Mesrop Mashtots” and RA “Movses Khorenatsi” Medals.

Is married with three children.
-->
